raid.description: Anti-raid: automatic lockdown when many members join at once

options.arrivees: Number of joins that triggers raid mode (config)
options.secondes: Length of the counting window, in seconds (config)
options.alerte_seule: Alert the staff without locking the server (config)

massban.description: Ban many members at once (IDs or recent joins), after confirmation

options.ids: User IDs to ban, separated by spaces or commas (200 max)
options.depuis_minutes: Also ban members who joined in the last N minutes
